summary: Frontend-only regression test for admin dashboard shell (navy DashboardShell w/ admin variant). All 11 requested test scenarios PASS. Admin login shows navy sidebar with CirebonKarir logo, blue 'Admin' badge, all 6 section headers (PELAMAR, PERUSAHAAN, LOWONGAN & LAMARAN, ANALITIK, MONETISASI, SISTEM); ownerOnly items (Tim Admin, Settings) correctly hidden for admin and shown for owner; owner shows gold 'Owner' badge with Crown. Navigation to /admin/jobs, /admin/candidates, /admin/analytics, /admin/audit-log, /admin/monetisasi all keep the shell and highlight the active menu (single active — count=1). Back to Overview highlights Overview. Bell -> /admin/notifications with shell intact. Command Center content (Business Health card, stat cards Pelamar/Perusahaan/Lowongan Aktif/Total Lamaran/Career Pro, Aktivitas 7 Hari chart, Quick Actions) fully renders in new shell. Mobile 390px: hamburger opens navy drawer with full menu + close button, no overflow. Regression: candidate (budi.demo) uses candidate-sidebar-desktop, company (premium@perusahaan.com) uses company-sidebar-desktop; no admin menu leak in either role.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: 500 errors observed on /admin/audit-log page load (backend), but out of scope for this frontend shell iteration — shell still renders correctly. Main agent may want to check the audit-log backend endpoint.

DashboardShell.jsx is now ~280 lines with 3 role configs — still readable but approaching the point where extracting CANDIDATE_MENU/COMPANY_MENU/CONFIG into a separate module would improve maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin shell unification complete. DashboardLayout is a pure delegator to DashboardShell with variant candidate/company/admin. Admin variant reads menu from props (ADMIN_MENU with ownerOnly filter applied in DashboardLayout). Section headers render as small uppercase blue-300/70 labels. Active menu uses bg-blue-600. Mobile drawer via admin-dash-hamburger opens admin-sidebar-mobile. All data-testids follow pattern admin-menu-<slug>, admin-sidebar-desktop, admin-dash-hamburger, admin-dash-logout, plan-badge, admin-topbar. Unrelated: /admin/audit-log backend returns 500 (surfaced in console) — separate issue not related to shell task.
